name: R013-ai-superpower-low-hp-faster
why: Challenge 7. The opponent leads with Nidoqueen 701 (Superpower, Sludge Bomb, Earthquake, Shadow Ball; White Herb, base speed 76). The player's Dusclops 378 (base speed 25, a Ghost type) burns it with Will-O-Wisp, then uses Seismic Toss (50 HP) every turn: about 197 -> 173 -> 99 -> 25 HP. Against a Ghost the AI scores Superpower -10 in CheckBadMove, so Nidoqueen never uses it and its Attack stays normal; the Ghost type is no-effect (x0), not a resist, so AI_CV_Superpower goes on past the type checks. With Nidoqueen faster and at 40% HP or less, the HP test takes the clean zero branch (battle_ai_scripts.s:2392-2404). If Dusclops faints first, Snorlax 826 (slower, Normal type) is the next target.
